title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python)
description: We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our payments platform team. You will design and build distributed services in Python, work with PostgreSQL and Kafka, and own services end to end. Requirements: 5+ years building backend systems, strong Python, experience with microservices and cloud (AWS/GCP), good English communication. Swedish not required. We offer hybrid/remote work from anywhere in Sweden.

title: Platform Engineer
description: Join our Core Infrastructure team to build internal developer platforms. You will work with Kubernetes, Go and Python, CI/CD, and observability tooling used by hundreds of engineers. We value strong fundamentals in distributed systems. English is our working language. 4+ years of relevant experience.

title: Systemutvecklare .NET (svensktalande)
description: Vi söker en systemutvecklare med erfarenhet av C#/.NET. Du kommer att arbeta i agila team med våra interna system. Flytande svenska i tal och skrift är ett krav då all dokumentation och kommunikation sker på svenska. Säkerhetsprövning krävs.

title: Data Engineer
description: We are scaling our data platform and need a Data Engineer comfortable with Python, dbt, Airflow and cloud warehouses (BigQuery/Snowflake). You will build reliable batch and streaming pipelines feeding analytics and ML. English working environment. 3+ years experience with data pipelines.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (Internship)
description: Looking for a junior frontend intern to help with our React app. This is an unpaid 3-month internship with possibility of extension. Great for students. HTML, CSS, basic JavaScript required.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend
description: As a Staff Engineer you will set technical direction for backend services handling billions of requests. Deep expertise in Java or Python, distributed systems, and mentoring. 8+ years experience. English working language, hybrid in Stockholm with remote flexibility.

title: DevOps / SRE Engineer
description: We are hiring an SRE to keep our autonomous freight platform reliable. You will work with Kubernetes, Terraform, GCP, Python and Go, and own incident response. 4+ years in DevOps/SRE. English working environment.

title: Product Manager, Payments
description: Seeking an experienced Product Manager for our payments products. You will own roadmap, work with engineering and design, and define metrics. Background in fintech preferred. This is a non-engineering role. English working language.
